show.description: In Bihar’s lawless heartland, small-time genius conman Keshav Kumar (KK) accidentally ignites a gang war after stealing an entire iron bridge to save a friend. Pulled into a bloody power struggle between liquor mafia don Chuna Chaudhary and ruthless MLA Tinku Yadav, KK cons, schemes, marries into crime, and outsmarts killers—until survival demands he stop running scams and claim the throne himself.
